description: This file defines functions, tokens, and aliases related to week-year calculations in the Moment.js library, including formatting, parsing, and utility functions for ISO and locale-specific week years.

methods.name: getSetWeekYear
methods.description: Gets or sets the week year of the current moment object.

methods.name: getSetISOWeekYear
methods.description: Gets or sets the ISO week year of the current moment object.

methods.name: getISOWeeksInYear
methods.description: Returns the number of ISO weeks in the current year.

methods.name: getWeeksInYear
methods.description: Returns the number of weeks in the current year based on locale settings.
